protocol.layout_prior: uniform; side and extent latent, not given to policies
protocol.parameter_prior: independent log-uniform E[1500,10000] Pa, K[400,16000] N/m
protocol.initial: 27 coordinates on center cross section under shared small axial/transverse dead load
protocol.probes: left or right end 0.03 N y force, observe three coordinates at that loaded end center; reset
protocol.target: all 243 coordinates under a separate asymmetric oblique load
protocol.physics: compressible Neo-Hookean, distributed isotropic Robin attachment, full or lower half end face, no gravity/contact
protocol.discrepancy: development residual mean and 10%-diagonal-shrunk covariance plus 1 micrometre SD floor
protocol.utility: expected posterior whole-field variance, joint numerical discrepancy conditioned on prefix and probe
protocol.calibration_rule: object-wise maximum across all budgets, coordinates and four repeats; 19th of 20 scores, 90% simultaneous bands
protocol.success: paired object-bootstrap 95% interval for RMSE improvement over best fixed excludes zero; calibrated simultaneous test object coverage >=90%; finite refinement checks pass
protocol.scope: new parameter pairs within four newly introduced fixture families, not unseen topology outside the prior; numerical reference, not learned PhysTwin
